samples.xml_description:
<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Implement a parallel to serial converter with MSB first.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel data input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid signal for serial output.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="s0" value="2'b00">State 0 description.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s1" value="2'b01">State 1 description.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s2" value="2'b10">State 2 description.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s3" value="2'b11">State 3 description.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <description>
            <item>Output dout is the most significant bit of data.</item>
        </description>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <description>
            <item>Combinational logic operation for dout.</item>
            <item>Sequential logic operation for data.</item>
            <item>Sequential logic operation for cnt.</item>
            <item>Sequential logic operation for valid.</item>
        </description>
    </implementation>
</module>
